why: Production (workflow-v2) paid the employer's laptop as business property: partially_covered, $2,500 (HB-1 sublimit), no exclusion cited. Its retrieval returned HB-1, WE-1, HB-2, WE-2 and no exclusion table of either attached form, so E-93 (property of others) never reached the model. Adjuster: laptop denied E-93, printer $1,300 - $500 = $800.

Production (workflow-v2) said covered for groundwater seeping through the foundation. NG-1101's exclusion table was in context but search_policy cuts passages at 900 characters, so rows E-44 to E-46 never reached the model; its reason rules out E-41 and E-42 only. Adjuster: denied under E-46.
